name: N'DA Nattè Jonas
title: Founder & CEO — Social entrepreneur | Biowaste valorization expert | Biodigester specialist | Program coordinator | Coach | Trainer
bio:
A Beninese social entrepreneur and specialist in biowaste valorization, biodigesters, biofertilizers, renewable energy, sustainable agriculture, tourism, and logistics. With more than 16 years of practice and involved in biowaste valorization since 2013, he puts his expertise at the service of sustainable development, environmental protection, green innovation, and climate action.

Founder and CEO of Bio-Gaz-Benin-Afrique SARL, a company specializing in biowaste valorization, the design and construction of biodigesters, organic biofertilizer production, renewable energy, the circular economy, and ecological solutions adapted to African realities.

He is also Coordinator of the Green Dynamic Climate Emergency Program (PDEV-UC), Northwest Benin, a sustainable-development program working on climate resilience, food security, restoration of degraded land, promotion of clean energy, sustainable waste management, green job creation, and the empowerment of youth and women.
education:
Professional degree in Transport & Logistics Management — University of Parakou
G2 Baccalaureate (Management & Accounting)
Bookkeeping certificate (CAP)
Several national and international certifications in entrepreneurship, renewable energy, sustainable agriculture, environmental management, and business development.
roles: Coordinator, Green Dynamic Climate Emergency Program (PDEV-UC), Northwest Benin
Representative for biowaste-valorization enterprises, Borgou department
Coach & trainer, University of Parakou's Center for Development and Entrepreneurship (CDE)
Manager and designer of sustainable-development projects
partnerships: Over the course of his career, N'DA Nattè Jonas has built partnerships with several national and international institutions, including: the Bernardin Gantin Foundation, Église Verte, NGO MAP Africa, the Borgou Waste Management and Sanitation Agency (SGDS), the Benin Environment Agency (ABE), the Dutch NGO SNV, ABC-EJASA, ABAOC Sahel, Bio Bénin, INRAB, and the France-Bénin Vendée Association of Natitingou, of which he is Vice-President.
international_experience: In 2026, he took part in a scientific study mission in Uganda focused on biodigesters, biogas, biowaste valorization, and circular-economy value chains. The mission strengthened his technical skills, connected him with international experts, and helped identify innovations transferable to Benin and Africa.
experience: Areas of expertise: biowaste valorization, biodigester design and sizing, biogas production, liquid and granular biofertilizer production, organic and regenerative agriculture, sustainable waste management, renewable energy, circular economy, climate resilience, green entrepreneurship, project management and coordination, professional training and capacity building, entrepreneurial coaching, transport and logistics, sustainable tourism.
vision:
To help make Benin and Africa references in sustainable development — where biowaste becomes a resource, every community benefits from clean energy, land regains its fertility, and young people build durable jobs through the green economy.

Through Bio-Gaz-Benin-Afrique SARL and the Green Dynamic Climate Emergency Program (PDEV-UC), Northwest Benin, he is committed to promoting innovation, scientific research, training, green entrepreneurship, and sustainable solutions for communities and environmental protection.
home_message: We turn Benin's waste into energy and fertile land — a conviction I've carried through more than sixteen years in the field.
